title: AlignCultura: Towards Culturally Aligned Large Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to the CULTURAX dataset, which is grounded in the UNESCO Framework for Cultural Statistics, using an automated LLM judge. The methodology scores models on Helpful-Harmless-Honest (HHH) principles and measures specific cultural failure modes, including stereotyping, cultural homogenization, over-sanitization, and context collapse.
